newsitem.title: USA: Westinghouse to announce spin-off this week - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Westinghouse to announce spin-off this week - WSJ.

text.p: Westinghouse Electric Corp will likely announce on Wednesday plans to spin off its industrial operations into a new company with a separately traded stock, the Wall Street Journal reported.
The newspaper said in its Tuesday edition the new company would have separate management.
It cited "people close to the situation" as saying the company's board of directors was expected to approve the proposed spin-off at a meeting on Tuesday.
Wall Street has been waiting for weeks for Westinghouse to go ahead with its plans, designed to increase shareholder value.
The two companies to emerge from the spin-off would each have estimated revenues of $5 billion a year, the newspaper said.
Westinghouse would assign most of the overall debt of more than $5 billion to the broadcasting side of the business because it was responsible for most of it.
